第34章 你是属狗的吗（第1页）
果然第二日他被主上打了两巴掌的消息，就迅速传遍了整个合欢宗。
其中反应最大的就是谎称在闭关中的常潇和那些翘首以盼的公子们。
因为那些灵仆不仅说蔺兰舟的脸上多出了鲜红的两个巴掌印。
而且嘴上也似乎被打了，红的厉害。
“楚子莫”她不禁一愣，忽然想起昨日在牢房中出现的绝色美男，当时牧原梦口口声声称他为子莫，莫非，竟然是那个救过自己的绝色美男么。
夏季闷热的天气之下，通风良好的大厅内部却没有安装任何空调设施--这里是地下结构非常的阴凉。
“那关于失踪人口事件，怎么处理，警察还沒调查出來，现在造成人心惶惶，还有一批员工已经辞职，近期还有人口失踪。”另一位管理又提出关键性的问題。
想到这里蔡冰儿真的不敢想下去，太可怕了，她不想去想。“墨寒哥哥，求求你放过我，我当时被仇恨蒙蔽了心，我不是有意要伤害莫浅夏的。”蔡冰儿突然哭了起來。
西灵魔族开始东进，在西鲁以东的熔川地区现在最是热闹，但是现在热闹的地方还不止这一个。就在魔渊和青毅杀入熔川，准备继续向东的时候，在灵心城刚刚新建政权的旭挺这边也迎来了一支大队人马。
“那，我先出去了。”张雷瞪了萧逸辰一眼，有些担心的看着林墨寒，听话的走人了。
“你安心去吧，杀你们两条狗，其实本来就费不了多大功夫”，展修面无表情地说道，望着仍握着刀柄站在面前的余雨，很想再往前伸一下下，只是双臂忽然一软，无力地松开了手中的短剑。
“十五！”李朝年撒谎道，尽力将自己弄得像那个年龄段，实际上他的行为举止早已超过了实际的年龄。
“认罚！我认罚！”光头陈也不胆怯，连着一口气的灌了三杯下去。
顾祎抿了抿嘴唇什么都沒说。抬起头反倒淡然的目光看着季安阳。不说话也沒什么太多的表情。但顾祎一看。季安阳就脸色暗沉了。阴沉沉的不好看了。
“爹爹，以这个港口为中心，将来还可以从国内移民，这一片的土地其实比台湾的还要肥沃。若是开发好了，便又是自成一方诸侯的基业。”郑森又补上了一句。
“不是吧，一场比试而已，至于用八门遁甲吗？”琉璃感觉头痛起来。
考虑到这些孩子的基础，所以郑森采取了最为填鸭式的方式：原理是什么你们统统不用管，反正你们现在也懂不了。你们只要记住该怎么做的一二三，并且将它们背得滚瓜烂熟就行了。知道怎么干就行了。

又是一名裁判这时候说道，宣布今天的比赛结束，叶枫依然拿走了第一名，这个成绩，绝对刷新了仙界历届以来的所有记录。
黑龙域内的很多强者，皆是对那个雅间内的老人家，并不陌生，此时感慨连连，颇有些搅混水的味道。
相较于那些蛮横无理的神族，北冥之海，似乎要采取一种更为温和的做法，而这种做法，确实很难让人生出恶感。
除此以外，还有许许多多的来自于世界各地的高手，此时此刻全部都汇聚在r国京东市。
徐少的笑容和阳光和煦，他似乎总是这样，一点也没有人们想象中的那种霸道。

Chapter 34 Are you a dog (Page 1)
Sure enough, the news that he was slapped twice by his master spread quickly throughout the Hehuan Sect the next day.
Among them, the ones who reacted the most were Chang Xiao, who lied about being in seclusion, and the young men who were looking forward to it.
Because those spiritual servants not only said that there were two bright red slap marks on Lin Lanzhou's face.
And the mouth seemed to have been beaten, and it was very red.
"Chu Zimo" she couldn't help but be startled, suddenly remembering the stunningly handsome man who appeared in the cell yesterday. At that time, Makihara Meng kept claiming that he was Zimo. Could it be that he was actually the stunningly handsome man who had saved her.
In the sweltering summer weather, there is no air conditioning facility installed inside the well-ventilated hall - the underground structure here is very shady.
"As for how to deal with the missing persons incident, the police have not yet investigated it. Now it has caused panic. A number of employees have resigned, and there are still people going missing recently." Another manager raised a key question.
Thinking of this, Cai Bing'er really didn't dare to think about it. It was too scary and she didn't want to think about it. "Brother Mo Han, please let me go. I was blinded by hatred. I didn't mean to hurt Mo Qianxia." Cai Bing'er suddenly started crying.
The Xiling Demon Clan has begun to move eastward. The Rongchuan area east of Xilu is now the most lively, but this is not the only place that is lively now. Just when Mo Yuan and Qing Yi entered the melting river and prepared to continue eastward, Xu Ting, who had just established a new political power in Lingxin City, also ushered in a large group of people.
"Then, I'm going out first." Zhang Lei glared at Xiao Yichen, looked at Lin Mohan with some worry, and left obediently.
"Go on with peace of mind. Killing you two dogs actually doesn't take much effort," Zhan Xiu said expressionlessly. Looking at Yu Yu standing in front of him still holding the hilt of the knife, he wanted to stretch forward a little more, but his arms suddenly softened and he weakly let go of the dagger in his hand.
"Fifteen!" Li Chaonian lied, trying his best to look like that age group. In fact, his behavior had already exceeded his actual age.
"Accept the punishment! I accept the punishment!" Bald Chen was not timid and drank three glasses of wine in one go.
Gu Yi pursed her lips and said nothing. He raised his head and looked at Ji Anyang indifferently. He doesn't speak and doesn't show much expression. But Gu Yi took a look. Ji Anyang's face darkened. It's so gloomy that it doesn't look good.
"Dad, with this port as the center, you can immigrate from the country in the future. This land is actually more fertile than Taiwan. If it is developed well, it will become the foundation of a prince of his own." Zheng Sen added.
"No, it's just a competition. As for using the Eight Door Dunjia?" Liuli felt a headache coming on.
Taking into account the foundation of these children, Zheng Sen adopted the most cramming method: you don't need to worry about the principle, because you don't understand it now anyway. You just need to remember one, two, three of what to do and memorize them by heart. Just know how to do it.
Another referee said at this time, announcing the end of today's game. Ye Feng still took the first place. This result definitely broke all previous records in the fairy world.
Many powerful people in the Black Dragon Territory are no strangers to the old man in the private room. They are filled with emotion at this time, which is quite confusing.
Compared with those arrogant and unreasonable protoss, Beimingzhihai seems to adopt a gentler approach, and this approach is indeed difficult to make people feel bad.
In addition, there are many masters from all over the world, all gathered in Jingdong City of Country R at this moment.Mr. Xu's smile was warm and sunny. He always seemed to be like this. He was not at all overbearing as people imagined.
